subtitle: 13 IDX-listed companies operating golf courses in Indonesia
data_sources: Annual Reports filed with IDX (Indonesia Stock Exchange) — public
Company official websites (course rate cards, membership pages)
methodology_notes: Inclusion criteria: IDX-listed entity with annual-report-disclosed golf course operations.
13 peers identified from initial scan of 21 indexed tickers (mining/fuel companies excluded).
All financial figures preserve original disclosure currency and unit; FY2024 audited preferred over AR text-extracted.
Missing fields shown as 'N/A — Not Disclosed' rather than imputed.
